description: This file contains utility methods for testing infrastructure in an Orleans-based project, including storage, event hub, and Redis checks, timing calibration, thread pool configuration, and grain activation counting.

classes.name: TestUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for testing, including storage, event hub, Redis checks, timing calibration, thread pool configuration, and grain activation counting.

classes.name: RequestContextTestUtils
classes.description: Provides static methods to manipulate and retrieve the activity ID in the request context.

methods.name: GetRandomGrainId
methods.description: Returns a random grain ID using the shared Random instance.

methods.name: CheckForAzureStorage
methods.description: Checks if Azure Storage connection string is available and starts the storage emulator if needed.

methods.name: CheckForEventHub
methods.description: Checks if Event Hub connection string is available.

methods.name: CheckForRedis
methods.description: Checks if Redis connection string is available.

methods.name: ForceTlsVersion
methods.description: Forces the security protocol to TLS 1.2.

methods.name: CalibrateTimings
methods.description: Calibrates timing measurements by running an empty loop multiple times and comparing elapsed ticks.

methods.name: TimeRunAsync
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous action multiple times, measures execution time and memory usage, and compares against a baseline.

methods.name: ConfigureClientThreadPoolSettingsForStorageTests
methods.description: Configures thread pool and ServicePointManager settings for storage tests.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Retrieves the activation count for a specific grain type via the management grain.
